snippets.power_query_m:
// Listar clientes — somente leitura. Base fixa + RelativePath para o refresh funcionar no servico do Power BI.
// chave = chave secreta (sk_...). Guarde-a em parametro do Power Query, nunca no texto da consulta.
(chave as text) as table =>
let
    Auth = "Basic " & Binary.ToText(Text.ToBinary(chave & ":"), BinaryEncoding.Base64),
    Chamar = (consulta as record) as record =>
        let
            Resposta = Web.Contents(
                "https://api.pagar.me",
                [
                    RelativePath = "core/v5/customers",
                    Query = consulta,
                    Headers = [Authorization = Auth, Accept = "application/json"],
                    ManualStatusHandling = {400, 401, 403, 404, 412, 422, 429, 500, 502, 503}
                ]
            ),
            // Com 401/403 o Excel devolve Response.Status nulo: trate com Record.FieldOrDefault.
            Status = Record.FieldOrDefault(Value.Metadata(Resposta), "Response.Status", null),
            Resultado =
                if Status = null then
                    error Error.Record("Erro Pagar.me", "Credencial recusada (HTTP 401/403): confira a chave secreta e a allowlist de IPs.", null)
                else if Status >= 400 then
                    error Error.Record("Erro Pagar.me", "HTTP " & Text.From(Status), Text.FromBinary(Resposta))
                else Json.Document(Resposta)
        in
            Resultado,
    TamanhoPagina = 100,
    Pagina = (n as number) as record => Chamar([page = Text.From(n), size = Text.From(TamanhoPagina)]),
    Paginas = List.Generate(
        () => [n = 1, r = Pagina(1)],
        each [r] <> null,
        each if List.Count(Record.FieldOrDefault([r], "data", {})) = TamanhoPagina
             then [n = [n] + 1, r = Pagina([n] + 1)]
             else [n = [n], r = null],
        each Record.FieldOrDefault([r], "data", {})
    ),
    Itens = List.Combine(Paginas),
    Tabela = if List.IsEmpty(Itens) then #table({}, {}) else Table.FromRecords(Itens, {"id", "code", "name", "email", "document", "document_type", "type", "delinquent", "created_at"}, MissingField.UseNull)
in
    Tabela

// chave = chave secreta (sk_...). Guarde-a em parametro do Power Query, nunca no texto da consulta.
(customer_id as text, card_id as text, chave as text) as table =>
let
    Auth = "Basic " & Binary.ToText(Text.ToBinary(chave & ":"), BinaryEncoding.Base64),
    Chamar = (consulta as record) as record =>
        let
            Resposta = Web.Contents(
                "https://api.pagar.me",
                [
                    RelativePath = "core/v5/customers/" & customer_id & "/cards/" & card_id & "",
                    Query = consulta,
                    Headers = [Authorization = Auth, Accept = "application/json"],
                    ManualStatusHandling = {400, 401, 403, 404, 412, 422, 429, 500, 502, 503}
                ]
            ),
            // Com 401/403 o Excel devolve Response.Status nulo: trate com Record.FieldOrDefault.
            Status = Record.FieldOrDefault(Value.Metadata(Resposta), "Response.Status", null),
            Resultado =
                if Status = null then
                    error Error.Record("Erro Pagar.me", "Credencial recusada (HTTP 401/403): confira a chave secreta e a allowlist de IPs.", null)
                else if Status >= 400 then
                    error Error.Record("Erro Pagar.me", "HTTP " & Text.From(Status), Text.FromBinary(Resposta))
                else Json.Document(Resposta)
        in
            Resultado,
    Bruto = Chamar([]),
    Itens = {Bruto},
    Tabela = if List.IsEmpty(Itens) then #table({}, {}) else Table.FromRecords(Itens, {"id", "first_six_digits", "last_four_digits", "brand", "holder_name", "exp_month", "exp_year", "status", "type", "created_at"}, MissingField.UseNull)
in
    Tabela

// Listar pedidos — somente leitura. Base fixa + RelativePath para o refresh funcionar no servico do Power BI.
// chave = chave secreta (sk_...). Guarde-a em parametro do Power Query, nunca no texto da consulta.
(chave as text) as table =>
let
    Auth = "Basic " & Binary.ToText(Text.ToBinary(chave & ":"), BinaryEncoding.Base64),
    Chamar = (consulta as record) as record =>
        let
            Resposta = Web.Contents(
                "https://api.pagar.me",
                [
                    RelativePath = "core/v5/orders",
                    Query = consulta,
                    Headers = [Authorization = Auth, Accept = "application/json"],
                    ManualStatusHandling = {400, 401, 403, 404, 412, 422, 429, 500, 502, 503}
                ]
            ),
            // Com 401/403 o Excel devolve Response.Status nulo: trate com Record.FieldOrDefault.
            Status = Record.FieldOrDefault(Value.Metadata(Resposta), "Response.Status", null),
            Resultado =
                if Status = null then
                    error Error.Record("Erro Pagar.me", "Credencial recusada (HTTP 401/403): confira a chave secreta e a allowlist de IPs.", null)
                else if Status >= 400 then
                    error Error.Record("Erro Pagar.me", "HTTP " & Text.From(Status), Text.FromBinary(Resposta))
                else Json.Document(Resposta)
        in
            Resultado,
    TamanhoPagina = 100,
    Pagina = (n as number) as record => Chamar([page = Text.From(n), size = Text.From(TamanhoPagina)]),
    Paginas = List.Generate(
        () => [n = 1, r = Pagina(1)],
        each [r] <> null,
        each if List.Count(Record.FieldOrDefault([r], "data", {})) = TamanhoPagina
             then [n = [n] + 1, r = Pagina([n] + 1)]
             else [n = [n], r = null],
        each Record.FieldOrDefault([r], "data", {})
    ),
    Itens = List.Combine(Paginas),
    Tabela = if List.IsEmpty(Itens) then #table({}, {}) else Table.FromRecords(Itens, {"id", "code", "status", "amount", "currency", "closed", "created_at", "closed_at"}, MissingField.UseNull)
in
    Tabela

// chave = chave secreta (sk_...). Guarde-a em parametro do Power Query, nunca no texto da consulta.
(charge_id as text, chave as text) as table =>
let
    Auth = "Basic " & Binary.ToText(Text.ToBinary(chave & ":"), BinaryEncoding.Base64),
    Chamar = (consulta as record) as record =>
        let
            Resposta = Web.Contents(
                "https://api.pagar.me",
                [
                    RelativePath = "core/v5/charges/" & charge_id & "",
                    Query = consulta,
                    Headers = [Authorization = Auth, Accept = "application/json"],
                    ManualStatusHandling = {400, 401, 403, 404, 412, 422, 429, 500, 502, 503}

            Status = Record.FieldOrDefault(Value.Metadata(Resposta), "Response.Status", null),
            Resultado =

                    error Error.Record("Erro Pagar.me", "Credencial recusada (HTTP 401/403): confira a chave secreta e a allowlist de IPs.", null)
                else if Status >= 400 then
                    error Error.Record("Erro Pagar.me", "HTTP " & Text.From(Status), Text.FromBinary(Resposta))

            Resultado,

snippets.power_query_m:
// Obter links de pagamento — somente leitura. Base fixa + RelativePath para o refresh funcionar no servico do Power BI.
// chave = chave secreta (sk_...). Guarde-a em parametro do Power Query, nunca no texto da consulta.
(chave as text) as table =>
let
    Auth = "Basic " & Binary.ToText(Text.ToBinary(chave & ":"), BinaryEncoding.Base64),
    Chamar = (consulta as record) as record =>
        let
            Resposta = Web.Contents(
                "https://api.pagar.me",
                [
                    RelativePath = "core/v5/paymentlinks",
                    Query = consulta,
                    Headers = [Authorization = Auth, Accept = "application/json"],
                    ManualStatusHandling = {400, 401, 403, 404, 412, 422, 429, 500, 502, 503}
                ]
            ),
            // Com 401/403 o Excel devolve Response.Status nulo: trate com Record.FieldOrDefault.
            Status = Record.FieldOrDefault(Value.Metadata(Resposta), "Response.Status", null),
            Resultado =
                if Status = null then
                    error Error.Record("Erro Pagar.me", "Credencial recusada (HTTP 401/403): confira a chave secreta e a allowlist de IPs.", null)
                else if Status >= 400 then
                    error Error.Record("Erro Pagar.me", "HTTP " & Text.From(Status), Text.FromBinary(Resposta))
                else Json.Document(Resposta)
        in
            Resultado,
    TamanhoPagina = 30,
    Pagina = (n as number) as record => Chamar([page = Text.From(n), per_page = Text.From(TamanhoPagina)]),
    Paginas = List.Generate(
        () => [n = 1, r = Pagina(1)],
        each [r] <> null,
        each if List.Count(Record.FieldOrDefault([r], "data", {})) = TamanhoPagina
             then [n = [n] + 1, r = Pagina([n] + 1)]
             else [n = [n], r = null],
        each Record.FieldOrDefault([r], "data", {})
    ),
    Itens = List.Combine(Paginas),
    Tabela = if List.IsEmpty(Itens) then #table({}, {}) else Table.FromRecords(Itens, {"id", "name", "url", "status", "type", "expires_at", "max_sessions", "max_paid_sessions", "created_at"}, MissingField.UseNull)
in
    Tabela

snippets.power_query_m:
// Listar recebedores — somente leitura. Base fixa + RelativePath para o refresh funcionar no servico do Power BI.
// chave = chave secreta (sk_...). Guarde-a em parametro do Power Query, nunca no texto da consulta.
(chave as text) as table =>
let
    Auth = "Basic " & Binary.ToText(Text.ToBinary(chave & ":"), BinaryEncoding.Base64),
    Chamar = (consulta as record) as record =>
        let
            Resposta = Web.Contents(
                "https://api.pagar.me",
                [
                    RelativePath = "core/v5/recipients",
                    Query = consulta,
                    Headers = [Authorization = Auth, Accept = "application/json"],
                    ManualStatusHandling = {400, 401, 403, 404, 412, 422, 429, 500, 502, 503}
                ]
            ),
            // Com 401/403 o Excel devolve Response.Status nulo: trate com Record.FieldOrDefault.
            Status = Record.FieldOrDefault(Value.Metadata(Resposta), "Response.Status", null),
            Resultado =
                if Status = null then
                    error Error.Record("Erro Pagar.me", "Credencial recusada (HTTP 401/403): confira a chave secreta e a allowlist de IPs.", null)
                else if Status >= 400 then
                    error Error.Record("Erro Pagar.me", "HTTP " & Text.From(Status), Text.FromBinary(Resposta))
                else Json.Document(Resposta)
        in
            Resultado,
    TamanhoPagina = 100,
    Pagina = (n as number) as record => Chamar([page = Text.From(n), size = Text.From(TamanhoPagina)]),
    Paginas = List.Generate(
        () => [n = 1, r = Pagina(1)],
        each [r] <> null,
        each if List.Count(Record.FieldOrDefault([r], "data", {})) = TamanhoPagina
             then [n = [n] + 1, r = Pagina([n] + 1)]
             else [n = [n], r = null],
        each Record.FieldOrDefault([r], "data", {})
    ),
    Itens = List.Combine(Paginas),
    Tabela = if List.IsEmpty(Itens) then #table({}, {}) else Table.FromRecords(Itens, {"id", "code", "name", "email", "document", "type", "status", "created_at"}, MissingField.UseNull)
in
    Tabela
